## Skills

I specialize in A/B testing and simulation — using simulation studies to turn complex statistical methods into practical tools: apps, Python libraries, and interactive analyses built to feel intuitive and effortless. Teaching and mentoring are equally central — I've built training programs, led TechTalks, and mentored peers on statistical methods and Python. AI-assisted development has meaningfully raised the pace and quality of everything I ship.
